question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become permanent public plugin SDK reply-payload exports for channel progress handling?
rationale: The additive contract is technically plausible and follows an existing fast-mode pattern, but public plugin SDK surface is a long-lived compatibility commitment that this review cannot approve from contributor discussion alone.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the two generic exports, repair every Slack render path, and add focused public-contract and channel regression coverage.

options.title: Keep the intent internal
options.body: Move the generic tool-progress signal to an existing internal or channel-owner seam and avoid expanding the third-party SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the two generic exports, repair every Slack render path, and add focused public-contract and channel regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history most strongly associates this person with the rewritten Slack delivery surface and adjacent reply-payload contract on the PR base.
